A '''species''' of [[Insect/Legends|insects]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Riileb/Legends|Riileb]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] eventually evolved into the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Riileb (species)|Riileb]] [[Species/Legends|species]], who could grow to between 2 and 2.75 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall. The precursor species were social in nature and possessed [[Antenna/Legends|antennae]]. They lived on the few islands amongst the [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], where they built complex labyrinth-like mounds to live in. The Riileb retained many aspects of the species's insectoid heritage including their antennae. They also built [[City/Legends|cities]] similarly complex to their ancestors mounds. [[The First Riileb]] to have evolved from the precursor species was an important figure in Riileb legend.<ref name="AE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Riilebs' precursor species was first mentioned in "[[Alien Encounters (article series)|Alien Encounters]]," an article written by [[Brian Smithson]] for the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 13|thirteenth]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]s'', a supplement to the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' by [[West End Games]] published in [[May]] [[1997]].<ref name="AE" />
